statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and unexplained syncope
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome (diagnosis I49.5)
The service was ordered for further diagnostic evaluation of the patient's recurrent episodes of dizziness and unexplained syncope
The service was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
Related diagnoses include R42 and R55
R55 reflects symptoms related to generalized weakness
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
